goal.request: Evaluate whether the implemented barrier_breakthrough_causal_event profile and candidate data survive into one independently authored, reference-guided, complex photoreal render.

evidence.claim: The requesting user asked for three independent random complex concepts, prompt generation from the supplied image, image generation, and pixel-level verification.
The inspected reference visibly supplies adult appearance guidance only: long center-parted dark wavy hair, dark eyes, softly arched brows, and broad face proportions.
The frozen v6 composed prompt preserves all intent anchors and all five literal barrier-breakthrough evidence fields.
The composed prompt and exact image render request both pass their fail-closed audits with zero failures.
Built-in image_gen delivered one saved native render on the single allowed call, with no retry.
At 288x384, the intact barrier, left-to-right force, fresh aperture, crossing ram, event hierarchy, and reference-guided appearance remain readable.
At 1086x1448, radial cracks, torn laminated edges, hydraulic contact, localized shards and spray, and the observable adult appearance all pass the precommitted gates.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: One coherent approach-contact-rupture-aperture-passage event must be visible through a finite resisting barrier while the appearance-guided adult remains readable.

invariants.statement: The same contact point must own barrier resistance, force alignment, fresh rupture, new aperture crossing, and localized displacement.
causal_controls: finite intact barrier around one breach
radial cracks and bent layers from the contact

invariants.statement: Only observable adult appearance cues from the portrait guide the new fictional scene; identity and protected-trait inference remain outside the claim.

mismatches.source_state: The authored prompt asked for the ram, leading shoulder, and one knee to occupy the passage.
mismatches.render_state: The ram clearly crosses the aperture while the shoulder and knee remain on the near side; the official object-or-force crossing gate still passes.

hypotheses.statement: When the five barrier-breakthrough evidence groups are hard-bound in one approach-contact-passage axis, the generator can preserve the complete official mechanism instead of substituting a generic explosion or victory pose.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any official gate fails at its declared scale, or the image shows only an explosion, preexisting doorway, rubble aftermath, or static pose.

intervention.general_rule: Represent barrier breakthrough as one finite-barrier, aligned-force, contact-rupture, fresh-aperture-crossing, localized-aftermath conjunction with strict same-image render gates.
intervention.generalization_basis: The rule encodes reusable causal topology and explicit confusion substitutes rather than the motivating subject, tool, corridor, palette, or reference portrait.

decision.rationale: This independent held-out arm passes all five official and five coordinator gates under the recorded seed, reference, prompt, and built-in generator conditions. The claim is limited to this tested condition; user aesthetic judgment and universal profile reliability remain unproved.
